FAQSection.title: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQSection.subtitle: Everything you need to know about EcoWarrior before starting.

q1.question: What is EcoWarrior exactly?
q1.answer: EcoWarrior is a web platform that helps you understand and act on climate change. We combine real-time scientific data, quality educational content, and practical tools like the carbon footprint calculator.

q2.question: Is it free?
q2.answer: Yes! Access is free and gives you access to the climate dashboard, Myths & Facts section, timeline and 3 free messages with our AI assistant. The Premium offer unlocks unlimited access and advanced features.

q3.question: Where does your data come from?
q3.answer: All our data comes from recognized scientific sources: NASA, NOAA, IPCC, CNRS. We regularly update our information to provide you with the most recent and reliable data.

q4.question: How do I become a Premium member?
q4.answer: You can go Premium in one click from your profile or the pricing page. Your subscription directly supports our mission: at 5000 members, we will sanctuary natural lands to protect them permanently.
